hooks.command:
python3 -c "
import sys, json, subprocess, re
data = json.load(sys.stdin)
cmd = data.get('command', '')
if re.search(r'git push', cmd):
    result = subprocess.run(['ruff', 'check', 'handover/', 'tests/'], capture_output=True, text=True)
    if result.returncode != 0:
        print('Lint failed — fix errors before pushing:', file=sys.stderr)
        print(result.stdout, file=sys.stderr)
        sys.exit(2)
"
